name: USB thumbdrive holder for M8 rod

captions.detailed: This 3D model is a custom mounting bracket or clamp featuring a cylindrical clamping loop, a hollow rectangular socket, and a hexagonal nut pocket. The main clamp section has a circular cutout with an open side, flanked by two parallel arms, one of which contains a circular bolt hole and the other an integrated hexagonal nut recess. Attached to the rear of the clamp is a hollow rectangular box-like socket, oriented perpendicular to the clamp's main axis.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric mounting clamp with an integrated rectangular socket and a hexagonal nut pocket. The design should allow the user to adjust the dimensions of the rectangular socket (H, L, and B) while maintaining a solid clamp loop with a bolt hole and a matching hex nut recess on the opposite side.
captions.factory: The design is constructed using a union of two main parts. The first part is a hollow rectangular socket created by subtracting a smaller cube from a larger cube, then rotated and translated into position. The second part is a clamp body made by unioning a rectangular base, a cylinder, and a side block, which is then modified using the difference operator to subtract a central clamping cylinder, a slot cutout, a transverse bolt hole (using a rotated cylinder), and a hexagonal nut pocket formed by intersecting and rotating three concentric cubes.
